Escolha farinhas, aveia, fermentos, temp: Choose flours, oats, yeasts, seasonings and vegetable drinks with indication of gluten absence. Oats need to be specifically labeled gluten-free. Use clean utensils and surfaces to avoid contact with wheat, milk and other allergens.
Ovos, amendoim, castanhas, soja, peixe e: Eggs, peanuts, nuts, soy, fish and sesame appear in some recipes and are flagged. Also check the “may contain” warnings on the labels. A lactose-free recipe is not automatically suitable for allergy to milk protein.
Lave as mãos e separe os utensílios usad: Wash your hands and separate the utensils used with raw meat. Use a cooking thermometer: birds at 74 °C, ground meat at 71 °C, fish at 63 °C and egg preparations at 71 °C in the centre. Reheat leftovers at 74 °C.
Refrigere perecíveis em até 2 horas (1 h: Refrigerate perishable in up to 2 hours (1 hour in heat above 32 °C), in shallow containers. Keep the refrigerator at 4 °C or less and consume refrigerated leftovers in up to 3–4 days. Do not rely only on appearance or smell.
